name: Shape morph: six forms
said: Port the Overprint concept as a Splashery labs toy.
now: One cloud re-forms between a word, the Lorenz attractor, a Klein bottle, a gyroid, a loop, and a QR code. The QR generator loads only for that form. Optional two-ink colors.

name: Shape morph: scatter and re-form
said: A splat cloud with visible motion at phone size.
now: Every splat has its own flight direction, scatters on a tap, and returns to its position.

name: Shape morph: push and settle
said: Dragging pushes the splats, and they settle back.
now: A drag in the view plane pushes nearby splats. They spring back after release, with an adjustable push strength.
